QUICK_CONVERSATION.TITLE: New quick message
QUICK_CONVERSATION.DESCRIPTION: Start a new WhatsApp conversation with an approved template. Delivery status is shown in the conversation.
QUICK_CONVERSATION.NAME: Contact name
